name: Watertown
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Watertown, WI 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Watertown, Wisconsin for 2026: the Parade of Lights, Santa House, Octagon House play and tours, plus nearby parades.
lede: Watertown starts its season with the Parade of Lights and Santa's House at Bentzin Family Town Square, then offers a holiday play and Christmas tours at the Octagon House Museum.
celebrates: The City of Watertown and the Watertown Area Chamber of Commerce put on the Christmas Parade of Lights, which the chamber describes as an after-dark parade with unique floats and lots of lights. Santa's House at Bentzin Family Town Square opens the same evening, so families can watch the parade and then see Santa. The Watertown Historical Society adds two Octagon House Museum programs, a holiday play with the Watertown Players and self-guided Christmas tours, and nearby Fort Atkinson and Jefferson hold their own lighted parades. Johnson Creek's village calendar adds a free tree lighting with Santa, wagon rides and treats, plus a Historical Society holiday weekend, and this page includes all of them.
lastyear: We did not find a published 2025 recap for Watertown's holiday events. The Parade of Lights is an annual Saturday after Thanksgiving event, which in 2025 fell on November 29, and the chamber describes it as an after dark parade with unique floats and lots of lights. Santa's House at Bentzin Family Town Square and the Octagon House programs return around the same weekend each year, according to the city and historical society calendars.
facts: The Octagon House Museum and America's First Kindergarten sits at 919 Charles Street in Watertown, and the historical society describes the holiday tours as self-guided. The Bentzin Family Town Square is at 1 West Main Street. Jefferson's parade is its thirtieth annual, presented by Generac, and Fort Atkinson's route crosses the Rock River bridge, according to the chambers.
trains: Watertown does not have its own Christmas train. The East Troy Railroad Museum, in Walworth County, runs daytime and evening Christmas trains and a free Santa Parade Train, and our museum guide lists it. Watertown families can plan a train weekend there after the parades.
train_links: Christmas trains and the Santa Parade Train, listed on our museum guide.
traditions: An after-dark downtown parade the Saturday after Thanksgiving.
A small Santa house at Bentzin Family Town Square.
A holiday play at the Octagon House Museum with a new show every 30 minutes.
Self-guided Christmas tours of the Octagon House, a new tour every 15 minutes.
Two nearby lighted parades on the first weekend of December.
A free village tree lighting with Santa, Mrs. Claus and horse-drawn wagon rides.
kidfact: Watertown's Santa House is a small hut in the middle of downtown, and the Octagon House has eight sides.
faq: Watertown celebrates with the Christmas Parade of Lights the Saturday after Thanksgiving, followed by Santa's House at Bentzin Family Town Square. The Octagon House Museum adds a holiday play and self-guided Christmas tours on weekends in late November and December.
When is the Watertown Christmas parade?
The City of Watertown calendar lists the Parade of Lights in the early evening on the Saturday after Thanksgiving, starting around 5:30 pm and running about two hours. It is free to watch.
Is there a Santa visit in Watertown?
Yes. Santa's House at Bentzin Family Town Square opens the evening of the parade, according to the City of Watertown calendar, and the town square's calendar may list more nights.
What is there to do at the Octagon House at Christmas?
The museum hosts a holiday play with the Watertown Players and self-guided Christmas tours. Both are ticketed and held on weekends, with a new show or tour starting every 15 to 30 minutes.
Are there other parades near Watertown?
Yes. Jefferson holds its Parade of Lights on the first Saturday evening in December and Fort Atkinson holds its lighted parade the next afternoon. Both are free and listed on this page.
